reason: I'd grab a single can from the café fridge after pilates or with lunch because 4 g of sugar and natural caffeine is exactly what I look for on a label. I won't order a 12-pack of something I've never tasted, though; if the first can isn't bitter I'll keep buying it at the café.
objection: Unsweetened yerba mate sounds like bitter grass tea, and I don't want to commit to twelve cans before I know I like it.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting a free can at a café or event and finding it actually refreshing rather than bitter would get me to order the pack or the subscription.
